answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake that thaws as slowly as a glacier before it can trade, and slash it when peers attest fraud. The stake only unlocks after a long horizon of honest deals, so creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes for months. Reputation also flows like a river of past transactions: agents only deal with counterparties vouched for by partners they have already paid. A sybil with no history and no locked stake finds nobody willing to trade, so the attack costs real capital, not just compute.
